Row keying: where one constant fronts several roster documents (MAX_ROSTER_BYTES: charge, serialno pre-check, key-pair digest, issuance receipt; MAX_BODY_BYTES: body), I emitted one row per document with the constant's definition as the key prefix and a bracketed document tag, listing every enforcement site in each, so each verifier receives one document. Merge them if the orchestrator wants strictly one row per constant.

Four whole-roster encodings in this family have no bound at all at head (housing.py:913 prepared receipt; housing.py:605 selected-serialno digest; columns.py:292-294 native_roster_sha256; columns.py:295-297 projection_sha256, the last ~440 MB at full source). The brief's classification list has no 'uncapped' class; I recorded them as `segment` with value 'none'. The orchestrator should decide whether they are rows or notes.

Upstream-shaped derived documents that never move with the fraction (the 292,484,053-byte full lexical projection under 8 GiB; the 374,174,650-byte catalogue record stream under 2 GiB) are classified `stays` with shape `upstream`, reserving `must-not-move` for real file sizes, widths and scalars as the brief defines it.

WGTP/PWGTP token widths are not in the section-4 inputs. The 3-digit variant reproduces the row-count lane's measured full-projection.json to 0.03% (292,401,960 vs 292,484,053) and the catalogue-record estimate lands 0.6% under the pilot receipt, so the selected-projection numbers (~28.5 MB / ~285.3 MB) are calibrated ESTIMATES, flagged as such.

Full-source selection semantics: the runner always passes an explicit key tuple (`serialnos=acs_keys`, survey_population_preparation.py:1946-1963, ACS keys only), so the issuance receipt, prepared receipt and serialno pre-check carry 1,531,614 entries at full source; the `serialnos is None` route (fixed-shape receipts) is never taken. acs_inputs.py, acs_housing_universe.py and source_csv_builtin.py were read in full and carry no byte bound (zero rows). acs_sources.py's only byte constant is a chunk size; its fetch path is reachable from no src module.
